mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past three months, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and insufficient monetary policy tightening (FEDFUNDS) signals an environment of rising real rates and reduced equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 5% yoy and FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an impending slowdown in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past three months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the past three months, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI exceeds 5.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0% yoy, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the interaction between GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO), a slowing GDP growth rate coupled with rising industrial production signals a temporary supply shock that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a soft landing.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth slows but INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery phase, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic momentum and corporate capacity utilization, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances during post-pandemic recovery when INDPRO increases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
